title: The West Don’t Rest
subtitle: Cornish grime. Icy bass. No rest.

lyrics.name: Intro
lyrics.note: Rain, distant thunder, crackling pirate radio
lines: From the coast to the estates.

lyrics.name: Verse 1
lines: Seven-thirty, rain beating on the pane,
Camborne in the morning, here we go again!
Redruth to Penzance, got a patch to run,
Boiler's packed up and the day's just begun!
Leak through the ceiling, water down the wall,
Get the right op booked when the customers call!
Damp on the plaster, TIC finds the cold,
Awaab's clock ticking, get the survey told!

lyrics.name: CHORUS
lyrics.note: Huge distorted bass, aggressive crew chant

lyrics.name: Instrumental
lyrics.note: Filthy sliding square-wave bass, rolling phonk cowbell

lyrics.name: Verse 2
lines: DRS flashing, Air Arc on the way,
Ops want a window, customers want today!
Forty thousand homes, that's a serious gig,
And the planning team's keeping the wheels on the rig!
Flagship thirty-one nine, Camborne twenty-seven six,
Different hours, different towns, yeah, I know the little twist!
Same big family, just reading what's online,
Could we get a little love for the Cornwall pay line?

lyrics.name: DJ Rewind
lines: DID HE JUST MENTION THE WAGES?!

lyrics.name: MC
lines: Just doing a bit of market research.

lyrics.name: Verse 3
lines: Big up the trades, out there in the rain,
Big up the planners keeping order in the game!
Another little problem getting fucking resolved!
We're not superheroes, ain't wearing no cape,
Just chasing appointments and drinking cold tea!
From the Cornish coast to the houses inland,
Good people doing what they fucking well can!

lyrics.name: Bridge
lyrics.note: Cowbell and low sub-bass, slower delivery

lyrics.name: FINAL DROP
lyrics.note: Massive distorted phonk 808 and icy grime synths

lyrics.name: Final Chorus
lines: GOT THE JOBS! GOT THE SKILLS!

lyrics.name: Spoken
lines: LiveWest repairs, how can I help?

artworkAlt: The West Don’t Rest: the hooded Planner FM MC at a rain-soaked Cornish repairs desk, with a stormy coast, icy blue lettering and violet radio equipment.
sleeveNote: Rain on the slate. Bass in the chest. Cornwall on the dial. The west don’t rest.

title: Planner FM: Diary Pressure
subtitle: Opening shift. Volume up.

lyrics.name: Intro
lines: YOU KNOW WHAT TIME IT IS!

lyrics.name: Verse 1
lines: Half-seven login, straight on the screen,
Twenty missed calls and the diary’s obscene!
Leak in the kitchen, boiler’s gone dead,
Oi! Where’s my op? Where’s my slot?
Supervisor’s asking what jobs we got!
Fucking hell, bruv, we’re booking all night!

lyrics.name: Hook
lines: GET THE OP ON THE PHONE!

lyrics.name: Verse 2
lines: Damp on the ceiling, taps gone bust,
Chasing the tradesmen, doing what we must!
Check the fucking notes, know what I mean!
No slots left? Better find a way,
Move that job to another day!
Overdues low, keep the board green,

artworkAlt: Planner FM: Diary Pressure sleeve with the hooded MC at the repairs-planning desk.
sleeveNote: Twenty missed calls. One very full diary. The repairs desk becomes the decks.

title: Three In The Morning
subtitle: After hours. No sleep. Bass deep.

lyrics.name: Intro
lyrics.note: Vinyl crackle, distant thunder, deep distorted voice

lyrics.name: Verse 1
lines: Three-year-old girl, little angel in bed,
Never slept a full night, doing in my head!
Up at one, up at three, up at four,
Little feet coming padding across the floor.
Six-year-old boy, little whirlwind of fun,
Solid as a nut, yeah, that's my son!
Absolute handful, heart made of gold,
Wouldn't swap either for the world, I'm told.

lyrics.name: Verse 2
lines: Clock in at work, eyes half shut,
Another damn job, another fucking rut!
Damp on the ceiling, mould on the wall,
Deadlines ticking and the customers call.
Back through the door, dad mode engaged,
Running on fumes but I'm back on the stage!
Love the little bastards with all of my might!

lyrics.name: Verse 3
lines: Finally some peace, no kids about.
Headphones on, let the bassline rip,
Roll up a spliff, take a slow little hit.
Smoke for the pain, let the mind unwind,
Another filthy bassline taking shape in my mind.
No sleep, no rest, but I've still got love,
Two little angels and the stars above.

lyrics.name: Outro
lyrics.note: Beat strips back to cowbell and sub
lines: Could do with a fucking kip though.

artworkAlt: 3AM sleeve: the hooded Planner FM MC at a glowing late-night desk between holographic astronaut and fairy children, with a moonlit coast outside and a Same Shit Tomorrow note.
sleeveNote: Headphones on when the house finally sleeps. Running on love and fumes.

title: Bellend FM: The Daz Transmission
subtitle: The Daz transmission. Nothing but love.
downloadName: Bellend FM - The Daz Transmission - yoxall.net.mp3

lyrics.name: Verse 1
lines: Who’s that bloke? That’s Darren, mate!
Solid geezer, one of the best,
Still a massive knob like all the rest!
Good old boy, but the facts don’t bend,
Darren’s a bellend, start to end!

lyrics.name: Verse 2
lines: D to the A to the double R,
E to the N, that’s our man,
Biggest bloody bellend in the whole damn gang!
Wanker on Monday, tosser on Friday,
Still got his back every single day!
No beef, no drama, nothing to prove,
Just a massive bellend with a filthy groove!

artworkAlt: Lyric-inspired Bellend FM: The Daz Transmission sleeve with the hooded Planner FM MC.
sleeveNote: One-four-oh on the dial. A rewind for Daz, with nothing but love.

title: Zoe: Here We Go Again (Unplugged)
subtitle: One eyebrow. An entire office silenced.
downloadName: Zoe - Here We Go Again (Unplugged) - yoxall.net.mp3

lyrics.name: Intro
lyrics.note: Soft fingerpicked acoustic guitar, radio crackle
lines: Poor woman's surrounded by absolute fucking idiots.

lyrics.name: Verse 1
lines: Zoe walks in, the diary ain't green.
Phone starts ringing, jobs piling high,
Another bloody emergency, here we go, sigh.
Someone's lost a job they were meant to keep.
Zoe looks up, doesn't say a thing,
That little fucking eyebrow says everything!

lyrics.name: Chorus
lyrics.note: Catchy acoustic hook, warm backing vocals
lines: Ohhh Zoe, here we go again,
Stuck in an office full of questionable friends.
One more job, one more call,
How the fuck d'you put up with us all?
Ohhh Zoe, what can we say?
Another bunch of bellends ruining your day.
But when the whole bloody place goes wrong,
She's still there taking the piss all along.

lyrics.name: Instrumental
lyrics.note: Acoustic guitar riff, deep rolling bass

lyrics.name: Verse 2
lines: Smara's got plans, Amanda wants house,
Jack's probably flirting with a sheep or a mouse.
Ops on the phone, customers too,
Everybody wants something, what can you do?
Zoe's got patience, or so we pretend,
We keep finding new ways to bring it to an end.
Another daft bastard getting put back in line.

lyrics.name: Bridge
lines: She's one of the good ones, don't tell her I said,
Or the praise might go straight to her head.
Nah, scrap that, can't let her win,
Someone say something stupid, get the eye-roll in!

lyrics.name: Final chorus
lyrics.note: Guitar, bass and crew joining in
lines: BUT AT LEAST THEY'RE YOUR FRIENDS!
BUT THAT'S NOT HOW WE PLAY!

lyrics.name: Outro
lines: Don't get fucking used to it.

artworkAlt: Zoe at the repairs desk with a knowing smile while the hooded Planner FM MC plays acoustic guitar.
sleeveNote: One eyebrow says everything. An acoustic one for Zoe and the office full of muppets.

title: Planning Team Tunes: Whole Crew Inside
subtitle: Full diary. Filthy bass.
downloadName: Planning Team Tunes - Whole Crew Inside - yoxall.net.mp3

lyrics.name: Verse 1
lines: Jack's from Wales, got a filthy mind,
Sheep start running when he falls behind!
Every joke's dirty, every punchline grim,
Someone call the farmer, keep the flock from him!
Smara walks in, and the whole room grins,
Sharp as a spark when the madness begins!
Runs this circus, somehow stays sane,
Surrounded by bellends, it's a fucking shame!

lyrics.name: Verse 2
lines: Amanda's on one, wants a four-four beat,
House music pumping, won't stay in her seat!
Says it's proper music, yeah, alright, love,
This ain't Ibiza, it's a fucking office, bruv!

lyrics.name: DROP
lines: Zoe's got that look, you know the one,
Half the crew's thick and she's fucking done!
Rolls her eyes, cracks a little grin,
Another day of dealing with the idiots within!
Darren's gone quiet, head down on the screen,
Actually asleep — the calmest he's ever been!
We thought Charlie was knackered, running on fumes,
But Darren's fully checked out in the middle of the room!

lyrics.name: Verse 3
lines: Ops on the road and we're all out of luck!
One's taking the piss, one's making a brew,
Nobody knows what the fuck we're meant to do!
Big up the names that ain't in the track,
Whole fucking team, yeah, we got your back!
Every last one of us slightly deranged,
Wouldn't swap the bastards, wouldn't have 'em changed!

artworkAlt: Whole Crew Inside — Planner FM: the hooded Cornwall crew gathered around a repairs-planning desk beneath storm clouds, with Cornish town signs, job folders and a One Job at a Time cup.
sleeveNote: The whole crew inside. Jack is unavailable. The sheep ornament knows why.

title: Cutter Is Go: Ctrl+Alt+Legend
subtitle: No cape. Just a restart.

lyrics.name: SPOKEN
lines: There's only one man for the job...

lyrics.name: VERSE 1
lines: Give him a system, he'll bloody well tune it!
Phil's already fixed it while scratching his head!
Built like a tank, but sharp as a knife,
Fixing our problems, saving our lives!
Ten screens open, fingers on fire,
Another fucking crisis, another live wire!

lyrics.name: PRE-CHORUS
lines: When the whole damn system goes down,
And the planners start running around...
One bloke stands, without a doubt...

lyrics.name: CHORUS
lines: WHEN THE SYSTEMS GO TO SHIT,
HE'S THE BLOKE WHO DEALS WITH IT!

lyrics.name: INSTRUMENTAL
lyrics.note: Fast punk guitar solo, soaring orchestral strings

lyrics.name: VERSE 2
lines: Some poor sod's deleted a job,
Another one's crying, "It's fucked up, Bob!"
Phil takes one look, lets out a sigh,
"Have you tried restarting it, you stupid guy?"
Knows every shortcut, every little trick,
Makes the rest of us look properly thick!
No fucking cape, no secret disguise,
Just a massive great geezer who's annoyingly wise!

lyrics.name: FINAL CHORUS
lines: FIXING OUR SHIT SINCE HALF-PAST DAWN!
HE'S THE KING OF THE SYSTEMS!
AND WE FUCKING LOVE THE BLOKE!

artworkAlt: Cutter Is Go cover: Phillip in a suit and red cape holds a telephone and points forward, surrounded by planning-system screens and cheering colleagues, with a darker cinematic colour grade.
sleeveNote: Someone get Phillip. Ten screens, one restart, all systems operational. Until the next tiny red light.

title: Get Your TICs Out
subtitle: Cowboys of the condensation.

lyrics.name: Drop
lyrics.note: Savage distorted Eskimo bass over banjo riff

lyrics.name: Verse 1
lines: Riding through the estate, got a job to do,
Black spots growing and the ceiling's gone blue!
Customer says, "It's been there for weeks!"
Grab that camera, let's have a little peek!
Oi! What's that? Cold spot there!
Damp in the bedroom, mould everywhere!
Whip out the TIC, give the wall a scan,
I'm a moisture-hunting motherfucking cowboy, man!

lyrics.name: Pre-chorus
lines: Well, she said, "Get your equipment out!"
I said, "Love, what's this all about?"
She said, "Show me what you've got!"
I said, "DARLIN', THAT'S A COLD SPOT!"

lyrics.name: Chorus
lyrics.note: Huge bass, rowdy cowboy gang vocals

lyrics.name: Verse 2
lines: Get that survey booked, no time to delay!
Air Arc humming, get the airflow right,
Mould ain't welcome round here tonight!
Damp in the corner, water in the wall,
Another bloody callback, another phone call!
DRS packed, no room for a slot,
But the TIC's coming out whether you like it or not!

lyrics.name: Final drop
lyrics.note: Twangy banjo meets crushing grime sub

artworkAlt: Get Your TICs Out sleeve: the hooded Planner FM MC as a damp-hunting cowboy with a thermal camera, banjo and novelty-bra prop.
sleeveNote: Banjo loaded. Cold spot located. The damp-and-mould cowboys ride again.

title: Phone Down, Bass Up

lyrics.name: Intro
lines: From the office to the afterparty!

lyrics.name: Drop

lyrics.name: Verse 1
lines: Half-seven start and the phone goes mad,
Another leak, another job to add!
Awaab's clock ticking, get the survey through,
TIC on the job, Air Arc crew!
Ops on the road, customers on hold,
Diaries packed and the coffee's gone cold!
Smara on deck, keeping us in line,
Zoe rolls her eyes for the hundredth fucking time!

lyrics.name: Instrumental
lyrics.note: Rolling house groove, distorted 808 and cowbell

lyrics.name: Verse 2
lines: Jack's got a joke that'll get us all barred,
Sheep across Wales putting up their guard!
Charlie's on low power, gaming till late,
Darren's fast asleep, fucking typical, mate!
Amanda wants house, so we're switching the beat,
Four-four rhythm got the whole crew on their feet!
Zoe's got a grin, Smara's shaking her head,
Another bunch of bellends, enough fucking said!

lyrics.name: Drop
lyrics.note: Massive distorted Eskimo bass meets phonk house

title: Practically Perfect (For Michelle)
subtitle: Bonus track. For my better half.

lyrics.name: Intro
lyrics.note: Gentle fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft vinyl crackle

lyrics.name: Spoken
lines: And that's putting it fucking lightly.

lyrics.name: Verse 1
lines: She's a nurse by trade, got a heart that gives,
Spends her days helping strangers live.
Then she comes home, another shift begins,
Two little faces with their cheeky grins.
Our boy's six, got a heart made of gold,
Full of mischief, impossible to control.
Little girl's three, an angel in sight,
But she's never understood sleeping through the night.
And there she is, through the noise and the mess,
Finding little bits of magic in the everyday stress.
I look at this woman, and what can I say?
She makes the world better in her own little way.

lyrics.name: Chorus
lyrics.note: Warm melodic male vocals, gentle layered harmonies
lines: Oh Michelle, you're the light in our days,
You turn all of our chaos into beautiful ways.
No magic umbrella, no flying away,
Just practically perfect in every way.
Oh Michelle, when the world gets too loud,
You're the one that brings me back to solid ground.
Through the laughter, the tears and the grey,
You're practically perfect in every way.

lyrics.name: Instrumental
lyrics.note: Beautiful acoustic guitar riff, deep warm bass

lyrics.name: Verse 2
lines: Now Mary Poppins had a trick or two,
But she'd last one bedtime, then she'd hand it to you!
A spoonful of sugar? Yeah, that's all well and good,
Try raising our two in this neighbourhood!
And I know there are days when you're tired to the bone,
When you've given so much, there's not much left of your own.
So when the world gets heavy, let me carry some too,
'Cause there's no one on earth I'd rather stand beside than you.
You're clever, you're gorgeous, you're funny as hell,
And there's a million little stories I could never quite tell.
Not some fairytale princess, no Hollywood scene,
Just the most incredible woman I've ever seen.

lyrics.name: Soft spoken rap
lines: And I know I don't say it
But you gave me a family,
And you made this life good.
But because I get to face it

lyrics.name: Final Chorus
lines: Oh Michelle, you're the light in our days,
You turn all of our chaos into beautiful ways.
No magic umbrella, no flying away,
Just practically perfect in every way.
Oh Michelle, there's one thing I know,
Through every little storm and wherever we go.
Of all the things that life could ever give me,
Nothing comes close to our little family.

lyrics.name: Outro
lyrics.note: Soft acoustic guitar, intimate spoken voice

artworkAlt: Practically Perfect sleeve: Michelle and her partner sit close together on a coastal bench in warm sunset light.
sleeveNote: After all the noise, this one’s for Michelle. My better half. Practically perfect in every way.
